content.text:
I added line clears and scoring in `index.html`, using a table of 100/300/500/800 points for 1–4 rows, times the level. Soft drop scores 1 per cell the piece actually moves; hard drop scores 2 per cell. The only verification was a syntax check; I did not run the game.
The scoring rule is written as a comment next to the table: clearing rows together must score more than clearing them in smaller groups. Soft drop into the floor scores nothing but still counts toward locking.
I did not add a test in `check/`: the logic lives inside the page script, and a test would only repeat the table. Once levels start going up, clearing rows one at a time at a higher level could beat a bigger clear made earlier.
